CustomField.description:
Controls whether changes made by the System Administrator are written back to the source system (CFIN).
For example, when a new account is created in CFIN and imported into Sailfin, the system may automatically update Profile Data or Segment Data. This setting determines whether those system-generated updates should be synchronized back to CFIN.
